note: H245: the loop's runner returned on the exit code before parsing the payload, so a REFUSAL and a CRASH were one event and the loop reported `could not be checked` over a metric it checked.

controls.name: C1_the_prefix_runner_really_does_discard_a_refusal
controls.must_fire_because: if it kept the payload there is no defect and the row is void; this is the arm that can retire the whole row
controls.can_fail_because: the pinned pre-fix runner returns the payload for `refuse_with_payload`
controls.null_must_contain: the pre-fix verdict for that shape

controls.name: C2_the_fix_does_not_swallow_a_crash
controls.must_fire_because: the mirror collapse. Trading `refusal read as crash` for `crash read as measurement` is not a fix
controls.can_fail_because: the live runner keeps a payload for crash, truncated or refuse_no_payload
controls.null_must_contain: the live verdict for all three

controls.name: C3_the_exit0_plus_error_lesson_survives

controls.name: C4_the_happy_path_is_untouched
controls.must_fire_because: a runner that broke exit-0 evaluators to fix exit-1 ones would trade the whole loop for one metric

controls.name: C6_NOT_A_LOOSENING_the_refusal_is_still_an_error
controls.must_fire_because: `is_eligible` is `invariants and not errors and pareto`. Returning only the payload would move an evaluator that refused while emitting IN-BOUNDS metrics from REJECTED to ELIGIBLE -- a path no other arm here touches, because hygiene's 0.0 fails invariants anyway and hides it
controls.can_fail_because: the refusal is dropped from `errors` once its payload is kept
controls.null_must_contain: the errors list from the end-to-end run

errors: hygiene: Exit 1: evaluator REFUSED, and its payload was complete -- the measure

controls.name: C5_NOT_A_LOOSENING_the_recovered_payload_still_fails
controls.must_fire_because: THE ARM THAT DECIDES fix vs loosening. hygiene_score 0.0 recovered from a refusal must FAIL invariants, and must fail as a VIOLATION, not as a MISSING METRIC
controls.can_fail_because: invariants pass with 0.0 present, or the run still reports the metric as missing
controls.null_must_contain: the recovered value, the invariant result and which of the two lines was printed
